'''Beeda Basin''' was a location on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It contained a sunken dead end where a concealed [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] cave was located, hidden from view except at a single point along the basin’s rim. This natural concealment made the location a favored rendezvous point for smugglers long before the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] came to control the planet<ref name="TG" />
